newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danisco down four pct after results.
newsitem.headline: Danisco down four pct after results.

text.p: Denmark's Danisco fell 3.9 percent on Wednesday after announcing 1996/97 net results up 14 percent on the year before, but warning of slower profit growth over the next 12 months.
At 0945 GMT the share traded at 415.00 crowns, down from 432.00 before publishing its annual results.

"For the accounting year 1997/98 an improved group result is expected. The rise, however, is expected to be less than in 1996/97," Danisco said in its results statement. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
